spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact contract — who consumes a snap area — via a misaligned programmatic scroll against an overflow:auto-clip rig, plus the computed overflow-y prerequisite the explainer names, not a generic CSS.supports check.

interactive.rationale: Run/reset buttons drive real scrollers and a live readout; the inner carousel is itself scrollable with a scrollsnapchange-fed settle readout.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a control-validated behaviour measurement with a computed-overflow readout; the page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the control-fails-inconclusive branch, the clip-preserved-but-no-propagation intermediate state, and the clip-coerced-to-hidden legacy state with distinct honest verdicts.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5086608215900160, the explainer, and sibling concepts.

conformance.rationale: The new feature suite mirrors the page: parse contracts pass today, clip-preservation and propagation assertions honestly fail on Chromium 141, and a hidden-still-traps negative contract passes.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (cloud fallback, no chrome-devtools-mcp available): control re-snapped 123→160 (edge 160), test stayed at 123 with the honest trapped verdict, horizontal settle reported card 2 at scrollLeft 140 via scrollsnapchange, zero console errors/failed requests, desktop+mobile screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the prerequisite readout, the control result, and separate propagation-active vs labelled fallback branches.

design_system.rationale: Only CSS variables (incl. --demo-color-064e3b/7f1d1d verdict colours at AAA on paper), 44px buttons, shared shell classes.

accessibility.rationale: Scrollers are keyboard-focusable with role=group and aria-labelledby, buttons are native with visible focus, readouts are role=status aria-live=polite, table has caption and row/col scopes.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800: no horizontal overflow after fixing the flag-token wrap and grid min-width, identical probe results, legible mono readouts on both.

openQuestions.title: Re-run the probe on a Chromium with SingleAxisScrollContainersForScrollSnap implemented
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 141 in the build container predates the implementation entirely (the flags exist in main but do nothing in 141), so only the trapped/legacy branches have runtime evidence. When a 157+ binary is available, run the probe behind --enable-blink-features=SingleAxisScrollContainers,SingleAxisScrollContainersForScrollSnap and confirm the propagation-active verdict and the conformance suite's two failing assertions flip to pass.

guidanceConsulted.query: scroll snap carousel accessible keyboard scrolling
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use the native scrollsnapchange event (snapTargetBlock/snapTargetInline) to sync UI with the settled snap target instead of scroll listeners.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The horizontal settle readout listens to scrollsnapchange on the carousel and falls back to scrollend + rect measurement when the event is absent.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel toggle buttons no horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grid/flex items need min-width:0 when children have max-content sizing; fix overflow at the source rather than masking it.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied .rig > div { min-width: 0 } and overflow-wrap:anywhere on the flag-name note; verified 0px document overflow at 360px.

summary: Behaviour probe with a self-validating control: programmatic re-snap measured at 123→160 in headless Chromium 141 (cloud fallback verification, not chrome-devtools-mcp), honest trapped verdict for the unshipped propagation, exact flag names from runtime_enabled_features.json5 in the banner.
